purpose: Teach: カフカ/スマトラ/フィレンツェ/朝鮮日報/ヤコブ/パシフィック/トリビア/バッジ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカフカの本を貸して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father lent you that Kafka book, didn't he.
lines.style: Warm, conversational observation. Gentle rise at the end like a soft confirmation rather than a question. The tone of a mother noticing what her son experienced. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとスマトラの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I looked at a picture book about Sumatra with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick attack on the opening word. Bouncing rhythm. The eagerness of a six-year-old who wants his mother to know exactly what he did. Genuine delight, not performed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフィレンツェ旅行のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was telling you about his trip to Florence, wasn't he.
lines.style: Gentle, slightly distant. A mother reflecting on the moment rather than interrogating it. Soft, almost wondering tone. Slight pause before the trailing clause—like she's picturing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと朝鮮日報の翻訳記事見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I looked at a translation article with Dad—from the Chosun Ilbo!
lines.style: Quick, eager delivery. Proud of remembering the name. The energy of a child who wants to show he was paying attention. Breathless between clauses. Slight emphasis on the newspaper name.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヤコブの梯子の伝記を貸して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father lent you that biography of Jacob's Ladder, didn't he.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. Almost to herself at first. The tone of a mother noticing a pattern—that her husband is sharing the strange, specific things he loves. Warm underneath. Slow pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとパシフィックリーグ観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched the Pacific League game with Dad!
lines.style: Bright and direct. Open, enthusiastic attack on the first word. Steady rhythm. The simple joy of a child reporting what he did. No need to embellish.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがトリビアな雑学を披露されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was showing off some of his trivia again, wasn't he.
lines.style: Affectionate amusement. A slight knowing smile in the voice. The rhythm of a mother who recognizes her husband's particular habit. Warm, not mocking. Relaxed pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと記念バッジ買ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I bought a commemorative badge together!
lines.style: Warm, satisfied completion. The final note lands gently—he's achieved something with his father and wants to mark it. The contentment of a small victory. Soft close, no trailing off.
